name: FedEx Ground Package Distribution Hub - Olive Branch MS (Memphis metro)

fieldNotes._identity: FedEx-specific branding could NOT be visually confirmed. 9181 Polk Ln sits in the Crossroads Distribution Center, a large multi-tenant industrial park in Olive Branch (Memphis metro). The roster geocode (RANGE_INTERPOLATED, moved 4m) is precise to the street address and lands on Polk Lane between two long cross-dock buildings; the building fronting Polk Lane at the roster point was audited. 2026 Street View shows mixed-carrier trailers (orange/blue/red dry vans, not the uniform white FedEx Ground fleet) backed in along the dock face - consistent with either a multi-tenant cross-dock or a FedEx Ground linehaul hub serving many contractors. Web research locates the documented FedEx Ground hub in Olive Branch at 8505 Nail Rd (330K sq ft, 94 acres); 9181 Polk Ln may be an address mismatch. Classification reflects the observed physical layout; identity flagged for human review.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The audited building's dock apron runs directly along Polk Lane with no perimeter fence and no barrier/gate across the apron - an open cross-dock face. No controlled truck gate observed; a sliding gate with call box exists at a DIFFERENT building on the E side of Polk Lane. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth observed at the audited building. guardShack false; remoteGs false (no gate).
